name: MERN
description: MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js: one language (JavaScript or TypeScript) from the browser to the database.

sources.note: a widely used name for this combination

name: MEAN
description: MongoDB, Express, Angular and Node.js: MERN with Angular instead of React.

sources.note: a widely used name for this combination

name: PERN
description: PostgreSQL, Express, React and Node.js: MERN with a relational database.

sources.note: a widely used name for this combination

name: LAMP
description: Linux, Apache, MySQL and PHP on a server you run: the classic way to host PHP sites.

sources.note: a widely used name for this combination

name: T3
description: Next.js and TypeScript in one project, usually with tRPC, Prisma, Tailwind CSS and NextAuth (create.t3.gg).

name: Django + PostgreSQL
description: Python's batteries-included framework with PostgreSQL; Django ships a module for PostgreSQL-only features (django.contrib.postgres).

sources.note: a common pairing; Django has a PostgreSQL-specific module (django.contrib.postgres)

name: Spring Boot + Angular
description: A Java backend with an Angular frontend: common in larger companies' business apps.
